# Third-party conceptual provenance and licence notes

This repository contains original code and original Markdown workflow text. It does not vendor, copy, or derive code or skill text from the projects below. The projects informed high-level ideas only; verify the current licence and terms before importing any future material.

| Project | Conceptual inspiration retained | Licence observed on 2026-08-29 | Future-use rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins | File-based skill/manifest portfolio and configurable role workflows. | Apache-2.0 | Treat as a separate upstream; preserve notices and review individual files before copying. |
| Anthropic Financial Services | Evidence discipline, financial model review, and declarative agent/skill organisation. | Apache-2.0 | Re-verify current upstream licence and source before reuse. |
| OpenBusiness | Claim classification as verified, inferred, or missing; research-to-memo flow. | MIT | Only reuse after file-level provenance/licence review. |
| Enthusiast | Grounded catalogue/listing concepts and review-oriented e-commerce workflows. | MIT | Do not import its RAG, vector, or orchestration architecture by default. |

Source records: [Knowledge Work Plugins](https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins), [Financial Services](https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services), [OpenBusiness](https://github.com/wanikua/OpenBusiness), and [Enthusiast](https://github.com/upsidelab/enthusiast). These links were checked on 2026-08-29. Licence status is a repository-level observation, not legal advice.
